edf:badAnnotations: Annotations must be a struct array with onset and text fields.
edf:badBytes: BYTES must be a numeric vector of the file bytes.
edf:badCompareArg: Each argument must be a file name or a struct from edf.read.
edf:badDuration: The data record duration of %s is not a positive number.
edf:badField: This field must be one text per signal (%d expected).
edf:badFileName: The file name must be text.
edf:badFileNames: The file names must be text.
edf:badFormat: The format must be one of EDF+, EDF, BDF+ or BDF.
edf:badInterval: Interval must be [t0 t1] seconds with t1 > t0 >= 0.
edf:badKinds: Kinds must be a kind name or a cellstr of kind names.
edf:badMargin: Margin must be a non-negative number.
edf:badOptionName: An option name must be text.
edf:badRate: The rate and record length give fewer than one sample per record for signal %d.
edf:badRateHz: RATE must be one positive number of hertz.
edf:badRecordSeconds: RecordSeconds must be one positive number of seconds.
edf:badRecords: Records must be [first last] with 1 <= first <= last.
edf:badSampleCount: A signal of %s has no valid sample count.
edf:badSelection: Give Signals or Kinds, not both.
edf:badShiftDays: ShiftDays must be one finite number of days.
edf:badSignalIndex: A signal index is outside the range of the signals.
edf:badSignals: Signals must be a label, a cellstr of labels, or indices.
edf:badSource: SOURCE must be a file name or a struct from edf.read.
edf:badSources: SOURCES must be a non-empty cellstr of file paths.
edf:badStruct: The second argument must be a struct with a signals field.
edf:badStructArg: The first argument must be a struct with a signals field.
edf:badUnit: TARGET must be one of V, mV, uV or nV.
edf:badUnits: Units must be one text per kept signal (%d expected).
edf:badWindow: The window must be two seconds with T1 greater than T0.
edf:bothWindows: Give Records or Interval, not both.
edf:cannotReadTemp: The temporary file cannot be read.
edf:cannotWriteTemp: A temporary file cannot be written.
edf:mergeMismatch: File %s does not carry the same signals as the first.
edf:noRate: Signal %d has neither a rate nor a samplesPerRecord.
edf:noSuchFile: The file %s is not on disk.
edf:notEdf: The file %s is not an EDF or BDF file.
